packages/core/src/math/getBorrowingPower.reason: The mutant flips `draw > ceiling` to `draw >= ceiling`. They differ only when draw equals ceiling, where the mutant assigns ceiling to draw, the value it already holds; the drawFee then used for the floor check and drawIcr was computed for that same draw. The registered survivor this replaces, `recommended > ceiling`, was the same shape under MK-118.
When the two caps are equal either choice is the same value.

draw !== 0n is evaluated only when !feasibleWith(draw, fee(draw)) is true, and it never is: the seed and at most one step above it keep draw + fee + reserve at or under the cap, which is exactly what feasibleWith accepts (both inclusive, BorrowerOperations.sol:1337-1349).

At cap equal to the reserve the mutant continues with available 0n, so the seed is 0n; a draw of 1 wei needs an entire debt of reserve plus 1 wei, above a cap that is the floor of the same ratio, so the walk takes no step and the function returns 0n, the value the guard returns. solveClosedForm reads nothing from the chain, so no read differs.

The walk cannot reach 64 steps. The seed is floor(available * P / (P + rate)); the largest draw d with d + floor(rate * d / P) <= available satisfies d * (P + rate) / P < available + 1, so d < seed + 2, and feasibleWith accepts exactly the entire debts at or under the cap the seed is sized from. The walk takes at most one step.
